ema_fast.name: Fast Exponential Moving Average
ema_fast.comment: EMA fast = ta.ema(close, length=n) with n = FAST_TREND_LOOKBACK

ema_slow.name: Slow Exponential Moving Average
ema_slow.comment: EMA slow = ta.ema(close, length=n) with n = SLOW_TREND_LOOKBACK

rsi.name: Relative Strength Index
rsi.comment: RSI = ta.rsi(close, length=n) with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

tsi.name: True Strength Index
tsi.comment: TSI = ta.tsi(close, length=n) with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

close_zscore.name: Z-score of Close
close_zscore.comment: Z-score of Close = ta.zscore(close, length=n) with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

efficiency_ratio.name: Efficiency Ratio
efficiency_ratio.comment: ER = change / volatility; change = abs(close - close.shift(n)); volatility = sum(abs(close - close.shift(1))) over n periods; with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

macd_signal.name: Moving Average Convergence Divergence Signal
macd_signal.comment: MACD Signal = ta.macd(close, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9)

macd_hist.name: Moving Average Convergence Divergence Histogram
macd_hist.comment: MACD Hist = ta.macd(close, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9)

ppo_signal.name: Percentage Price Oscillator Signal
ppo_signal.comment: PPO Signal = ta.ppo(close, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9)

ppo_hist.name: Percentage Price Oscillator Histogram
ppo_hist.comment: PPO Hist = ta.ppo(close, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9)

ulcer_index.name: Ulcer Index
ulcer_index.comment: Ulcer Index = ta.ui(close, length=n) with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

cmo.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
cmo.comment: CMO = ta.cmo(close, length=n) with n = MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK

mb.name: Middle Bollinger Band
mb.comment: Middle Bollinger Band = ta.sma(close, length=n) with n = TREND_LOOKBACK

std.name: Standard Deviation
std.comment: Standard Deviation = ta.stdev(close, length=n) with n = TREND_LOOKBACK

ub.name: Upper Bollinger Band
ub.comment: Upper Bollinger Band = ta.sma(close, length=n) + 2 * ta.stdev(close, length=n) with n = TREND_LOOKBACK

lb.name: Lower Bollinger Band
lb.comment: Lower Bollinger Band = ta.sma(close, length=n) - 2 * ta.stdev(close, length=n) with n = TREND_LOOKBACK

cci.name: Commodity Channel Index
cci.comment: CCI = (typical_price - rolling mean typical_price) / (0.015 * mean absolute deviation)

kdj_k.name: KDJ K
kdj_k.comment: Smoothed stochastic RSV over MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

fisher.name: Fisher Transform
fisher.comment: Fisher transform of median price position within the rolling high-low range

kama.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
kama.comment: Adaptive moving average weighted by efficiency ratio

high_ma_bias.name: High Price MA Bias
high_ma_bias.comment: (High - rolling mean High) / rolling mean High with n = FAST_TREND_LOOKBACK

change_std.name: Return Change Std
change_std.comment: Close.pct_change(n) * rolling std of one-bar returns adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

dpo.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
dpo.comment: (Close - shifted rolling mean Close) / rolling mean Close

pfe.name: Polarized Fractal Efficiency
pfe.comment: Direction-signed price efficiency based on direct distance divided by path distance

slow_stoch_d.name: Slow Stochastic D
slow_stoch_d.comment: Slow stochastic oscillator D line adapted from SKDJ

coppock.name: Coppock Curve
coppock.comment: Rolling mean of combined n-period and 2n-period close ROC

smi.name: Stochastic Momentum Index
smi.comment: Smoothed close distance from rolling high-low midpoint

psy.name: Psychological Line
psy.comment: Percent of bars in lookback where Close rose

return_autocorr.name: Return Autocorrelation
return_autocorr.comment: Rolling correlation of one-bar returns with lagged returns

demarker.name: DeMarker
demarker.comment: Rolling positive high movement divided by positive high plus low movement

imi.name: Intraday Momentum Index
imi.comment: Rolling close-open up movement divided by total close-open movement

rvi.name: Relative Volatility Index
rvi.comment: Upward close volatility divided by upward plus downward close volatility

ultimate_oscillator_src.name: Ultimate Oscillator Source
ultimate_oscillator_src.comment: Triple-timeframe buying pressure oscillator adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

kst.name: Know Sure Thing
kst.comment: Weighted multi-horizon close ROC oscillator normalized by its rolling mean

rmi.name: Relative Momentum Index
rmi.comment: Four-bar positive close momentum divided by rolling absolute close movement

tii.name: Trend Intensity Index
tii.comment: Normalized ratio of positive close deviations from rolling mean

ar.name: Atmosphere Ratio
ar.comment: 100 * rolling sum(High - Open) / rolling sum(Open - Low)

br.name: Bull Bear Ratio
br.comment: 100 * rolling sum(High - previous Close) / rolling sum(previous Close - Low)

cr.name: Closing Rate
cr.comment: 100 * rolling upward pressure over previous typical price divided by downward pressure

adtm.name: Advance Dynamic Trend Momentum
adtm.comment: (rolling DTM - rolling DBM) / max(rolling DTM, rolling DBM)

qstick.name: Qstick
qstick.comment: (Close - Open) normalized by rolling mean Close - Open

rbias.name: Rate of Bias
rbias.comment: One-bar rate of change of Close / rolling mean Close

mtm_mean.name: Momentum Mean
mtm_mean.comment: Rolling mean of n-period close momentum

mtm_max_diff.name: Momentum Max Difference
mtm_max_diff.comment: Current n-period momentum minus prior rolling max momentum

sroc.name: Smoothed ROC
sroc.comment: Rate of change of EMA-smoothed Close over 2n bars

rsi_mean.name: RSI Mean

tdi.name: Traders Dynamic Index

osc.name: Close Moving Average Oscillator

long_quiet_momentum.name: Long Quiet Momentum

price_volume_momentum.name: Price Volume Momentum

dbcd.name: Divergence of Bias
dbcd.comment: Rolling average of close moving-average bias divergence

pmarp.name: PMARP
pmarp.comment: Percentile rank of absolute close-to-moving-average ratio

pos.name: Return Position

bias36.name: Bias36

swing_index.name: Swing Index

cmo_v2.name: CMO v2

return_autocorr_2.name: Return Autocorrelation 2

erbear.name: Bear Power
